title: Actor Bill Murray stuns Trump's top economic advisor with bizarre question on news show
summary: Bill Murray asked Kevin Hassett to say "my dog just died" on CNBC's "Squawk Box" to test his ever-present smile during a live interview moment Monday.

title: Battleground Dem touts bipartisan record, but can’t name single issue she’d work with Trump on
summary: Democratic Senate candidate Peggy Flanagan touted her bipartisan record but couldn't name one Trump policy she'd support, citing "continued grift."

title: Supreme Court denies Trump admin request to reverse block on segregating 20K California ballots
summary: The Supreme Court rejected the Trump administration's request to segregate more than 20,000 California mail-in ballots flagged for potential noncitizen voting.

title: Trump takes midterm campaign blitz to historic stage for grand finale before Election Day
summary: President Donald Trump brings his whirlwind midterm campaign to a close in Washington, D.C., after weeks of rallies, celebrity appearances and memorable moments on the road.

title: Mamdani says Trump agrees to grant visa so mother can attend funeral of teen killed in Bronx shooting
summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said President Donald Trump agreed to grant a visa to the mother of a 15-year-old who was fatally shot in the Bronx last week.

title: US will mediate upcoming Ukraine-Russia talks in Abu Dhabi, Witkoff says
summary: U.S. Special Envoy Steve Witkoff announced U.S.-mediated peace talks between Ukraine and Russia on Nov. 10 and 11, focusing on security arrangements and de-escalation.

title: How a midterm tie gets settled in the case of the Senate
summary: A tied Senate could leave control of the chamber uncertain after the 2026 midterm elections. Past 50-50 splits in 2000 and 2020 offer clues about how lawmakers could negotiate power sharing agreements in 2027.

title: Bill Belichick doesn't have time for questions about relationship with Jordon Hudson after near Miami upset
summary: Bill Belichick fired back at a reporter who asked about his reported Jordon Hudson breakup at a press conference, asking if he works for a tabloid.

title: Russia plotting 'massive strike' during midterms, Zelenskyy warns, urges US to stop Putin
summary: Zelenskyy says Russia plans a massive attack on Ukraine's energy infrastructure while the world watches Tuesday's U.S. midterm elections unfold.

title: Shoppers love Particle's new cologne — and FOX readers can save 25%
summary: Particle's Gravité cologne blends bright citrus with warm wood and musk, and FOX readers can save 25% with code FOXSAVE through Nov. 30.
